pre_update_notes: A minor release on top of 2.2.0: a much bigger SEO toolkit — daily SEO Audit with alerts, focus keyword and content analysis, wildcard/regex redirects with groups and expiry, 410 Gone, hreflang in the sitemap, an AI Crawlers page, a Setup Guide, and Search Console history. It applies 6 small additive database migrations (new columns on redirects, pages, blog posts, brands and car models, and two new tables for Search Console history and AI crawler visits) — nothing in your products, orders, invoices, payments or customers is changed or removed. Update from a single browser tab and leave the update page open until it finishes.
post_update_notes: After the update: (1) open the SEO Setup Guide and set a default share image. (2) Make sure the scheduler cron is running: it now runs the daily SEO audit (06:30), the Search Console snapshot (05:45) and the weekly external-link check (Sunday 03:30). (3) The Search Console connection needs the 'webmasters' scope for the history chart. Thin-content noindex, AI-crawler tracking and audit alerts are optional and can be switched off in the SEO Control Center.
